_source: constants extracted from exp-f01/out/protocol-draft.json (fold boundaries, A5 gate denominators, D7 proxy calibration); parent exp-003 sweep best (transferred arm-A config)
d7_mapping_rule: proxy_ratio = armA_valid_mean / example_valid_mean(fold1); calib_ratio(f) = armA_valid_mean * ratio_test_over_valid(f) / denominator_floored(f); sizing/scheduling only
feasibility_rule: rank point feasible iff VRAM peak <= 44 GB AND (best of base/named-variant) armB s/step <= 10x armA s/step at the planned architecture

phase4.plateau_rule: smoothed(v) = mean of last 3 VALID evals; N* = step of best smoothed; stop when step - N*_step >= 3000 (12 evals with no improvement > 0.0005) or max_steps reached
